sequencing_rules: Primary Dx is the condition chiefly responsible for the encounter as documented in the chief-complaint or assessment.
Code signs and symptoms when no confirmed Dx exists; never up-code 'rule out' to the unconfirmed Dx.
Never combine ICD codes from different encounter dates without operator override.
Cite the documentation span for every proposed code; no citation, no proposal.
End every coder-facing artifact with the cardinal-rule disclaimer.

same_day_em_with_minor_procedure.rationale: Significant, separately identifiable E&M on same day as procedure

distinct_procedural_service.rationale: Distinct procedural service same day; only when no more specific modifier applies

payer_rules_seed.summary: Coverage requires documented osteoporosis risk factor; screening DEXA limited to once per 24 months.
Modifier -25 requires the E&M note to stand alone from the procedure note; insufficient documentation triggers automatic line denial.

denied_codes_history_seed.denial_summary: Non-covered services; not deemed medical necessity by payer.
Benefit included in another adjudicated service (NCCI bundle).
Modifier inconsistent with documentation; E&M did not stand alone.
Benefit maximum reached (annual wellness visit cadence).
Debridement depth not supported by documentation.
